official_sources.authority: Department for Levelling Up, Housing and Communities / Planning Data
claims: API exposes over 100 planning and housing datasets through a consistent interface.
Coordinate queries return entities whose geometry intersects the point; multiple dataset parameters are supported.
UPRN may be supplied with q and is described as more precise than coordinate lookup for registered properties.
Entity results can include dataset, reference, start-date, WKT geometry and WKT point.
WKT geometry queries use WGS84 EPSG:4326 and geometry_relation has explicit spatial predicates.
Large result sets use limit and offset; response links provide next, previous, first and last navigation.
No batch endpoint is documented; bulk CSV, JSON, GeoJSON and Parquet downloads are recommended for large portfolios.
Absence of API results is not proof that no constraint exists because coverage varies by area.
API is beta and production consumers must retain schema and currentness guards.

quality_guards: Do not infer candidate identity from a nearby coordinate when exact entity bytes are absent.
Do not equate a dataset-level title-boundary record with an HMLR registered-title polygon.
Preserve start-date and quality semantics when comparing API and bulk snapshots.
Fail closed when exact entity response bytes for references 52040420, 52213916 and 52213412 are unavailable.
